title: Discharge.
officialText:
Blowoff/blowdown valves shall discharge to a safe place of disposal. Where discharging to the drainage
system, the installation shall conform to the New York City Plumbing Code.
SECTION MC 1009
HOT WATER BOILER EXPANSION TANK
